GMG / V-cycle / Vサイクル 追加の固定入力例 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 条件・文献の個別整理：2026-11-22 解く問題と採用形 解く問題定係数Poisson方程式の五点差分連立系。採用した変種・範囲再離散化した粗格子作用素とfull weighting/双線形転送を使う、red-black GSの幾何V-cycle。 使える条件 規則的な入れ子正方格子のPoissonを解くとき。 緩和だけでは減りにくい滑らかな誤差と粗格子補正を比較して学ぶとき。 避ける条件・追加処理が必要な場合 非入れ子格子、曲がった領域、係数の強い異方性をそのまま入力する場合。 この例をそのままAMGや汎用楕円ソルバーとみなす場合。 解説と位置付け 解説章を読む 前提・比較仕様 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。 粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。 最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。 条件を記載: 格子条件・転送・平滑化・粗格子解法を関数から確認した。 境界条件: [0,1]² の全辺で u=0。誤差補正も零Dirichletで、ゼロ埋め込みにより境界値を入れる。 条件を記載: 作用素と転送は零Dirichletのゼロ埋め込みを使う。 単位系: 公開問題は無次元の [0,1]²、h=1/(n+1)。次元を与える場合 [f]=[u]/[長さ]²、残差ノルムは格子重みなし。 条件を記載: The public implementation is a fixed-hierarchy V-cycle for zero-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square. Other names: マルチグリッド法 / 多重格子法 / multigrid method / geometric multigrid / GMG / V-cycle / Vサイクル Additional fixed-input examples Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Method-specific conditions and sources: 2026-11-22 Problem and adopted formulation ProblemThe five-point discrete system for constant-coefficient Poisson.Variant and scopeGeometric V-cycle with rediscretized coarse operators, full weighting, bilinear transfer and red-black GS. Use when Solving Poisson on a regular nested square hierarchy. Studying smooth-error removal by coarse correction versus relaxation alone. Avoid or add further treatment when Direct input of non-nested meshes, curved domains or strongly anisotropic coefficients. Treating this example as AMG or a general elliptic solver. Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions and comparison specification Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis. Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default. The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual. Specified: Inspected grid restrictions, transfer, smoothing and coarse solve. Boundaries: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding. Specified: Operator and transfer use zero padding for zero Dirichlet boundaries. Units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights. Specified: Checked unit-square and h conventions. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established. Specified: Scoped to the implemented geometric V-cycle.
